# Cappuccino Bag

Cappuccino Bag supports B2B OEM/ODM development of bags and carrying accessories for racket sports, outdoor use and travel.

Public inquiry email: info@cappuccinobag.net
Public WhatsApp: +86 139 2871 5568

- [OEM/ODM bag development](https://www.cappuccinobag.com/oem-odm-bag-manufacturer): Custom bag development and manufacturing overview.

## Commercial and content interpretation
Custom MOQ is 300 pcs per style; special proposals require manual review. Design approval precedes separately authorized physical sampling and any sample fee. An RFQ does not authorize charges. Specifications, materials, lead times, pricing and compliance documentation require project-specific confirmation. Read product imagery with its visible concept or sample status.
